excluded: NRSC/TanDEM-X terrain or numerical breach inputs
data_policy.note: NRSC is used only to identify the requested scenario definition, not as a source of numerical model inputs.

copernicus_dem.note: 8 m output grid is not equivalent to native 8 m source detail.

available_inputs.nisar_note: Bara Shigri is a separate glacier monitoring area; its velocity is not Samudra Tapu breach forcing.

scenario_interpretation.100_percent_release: Hypothetical complete-release assumption only. No released volume or hydrograph can be calculated without lake storage.
scenario_interpretation.overtopping: Scenario label only. Breach dimensions and formation time are not available from current permitted inputs.
scenario_interpretation.PMS_storm: Stress-test label only. No rainfall depth, spatial distribution, temporal pattern or runoff hydrograph is available from current permitted inputs.

outputs_not_allowed: probability or timing of an actual GLOF

required_before_hydrodynamic_run: Lake storage or defensible volume/elevation relationship
Breach width/depth/side slopes and formation time with documented basis
PMP rainfall time series and spatial distribution if PMS runoff is modelled
Continuous channel/floodplain terrain without critical NoData gaps
Channel roughness values and sensitivity analysis
Upstream and downstream hydraulic boundary conditions
Independent observed flood extent, water level or discharge for validation

validation_gates.test: Visual Sentinel-2 lake-boundary, cloud/shadow, ROI and threshold-sensitivity review
Check internal NoData around outlet and full downstream analysis corridor
validation_gates.status: OPEN — known internal NoData near current trace endpoint

validation_gates.test: Verify outlet against imagery/terrain and test nearby outlet candidates
Demonstrate continuous downstream drainage to a defensible termination
Verify lake storage, breach hydrograph and rainfall-runoff forcing
Validate hydraulic outputs against independent observations

publication_label: Scenario-7-inspired satellite-only terrain susceptibility and potential flow-corridor assessment — not a flood forecast.
